say:2:1025119001:0.source_cn: 主人，主人！\n科丝蒂刚才找我道歉啦！

say:3:1025119002:0.text: Did Cassadee come to visit you?

say:4:1025119003:0.text:
Yes! She just left. She's actually a very nice person.
She also made Chippy a dessert.
say:4:1025119003:0.source_cn: 嗯！她刚离开，其实她人还挺好的嘞。\n还送了我亲手做的...

say:5:1025119004:0.text: It's easy to get on your good side, isn't it? How does it taste?
say:5:1025119004:0.source_cn: 这么简单就被打动了？那么——好吃吗？

say:6:1025119005:0.text:
Chippy was just about to have a bite!
*Nom nom nom*...
say:6:1025119005:0.source_cn: 满满正准备尝尝呢！\n啊呜——

say:7:1025119006:0.text: ...*Cough*... It's so sweet! Water! Chippy needs water!
say:7:1025119006:0.source_cn: ——咳咳咳！怎么这么甜！水，快给我水——！！！
